english.title: Carry / remove / deposit / harbour / keep / conceal imported seal skins from a warehouse to evade a prohibition

english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(b), (3) and (4B) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly concerned in
carrying / removing / depositing or
harbouring / keeping / concealing / dealing
with commercially imported seal skins
which had unlawfully been removed
from a warehouse / King's warehouse
with intent
to evade the prohibition
on the commercial importation of seal skins

english.notes:
(i) Any goods in respect of which an offence under this section is committed shall be liable to forfeiture.
(ii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.
